verdict.rationale: A coding agent can scaffold a voice agent with the official CLI (`pipecat init`, which also writes AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md) and deploy it via `pipecat cloud`. It can run the agent against telephony from code (`python bot.py -t twilio`), with the carrier calling the bot's webhook. However, number provisioning lives with the external carrier (Twilio, Telnyx and similar), and the only MCP server is a docs and examples context hub rather than a provisioning surface. missing for 10: Pipecat-native API/CLI/MCP for attaching a phone number, evidence of placing an outbound call programmatically, an MCP server that provisions resources (not just docs), a public provisioning API spec (OpenAPI probe 404), independent end-to-end corroboration.
